decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PA-02, PA-03 Received: 23 November 2018;  PA-01 Received: 27 November 2018; PA-04, PA-05 Received: 17 January 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No jet wash machinery shall be operated outside the following times:  07.00 to 22.00 from Monday to Saturday and 10.00 to 16.00 on Sunday.

Condition : 4 - Before the jet wash is first brought into operation details of how waste water from the use of the jet wash will be collected, filtered, treated and discharged into the main sewer, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the installation shall be operated in accordance with the details so approved.
description: Installation of a new jet wash
